name: io.github.Srikarmk/evalpair
title: evalpair
description: Run LLM eval suites on local or hosted models; compare runs with intervals and a noise floor.

environmentVariables.name: EVALPAIR_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the call cache, saved runs and your own suites (default ~/.evalpair).

environmentVariables.name: EVALPAIR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for an OpenAI-compatible server, if it needs one (OPENAI_API_KEY also works).
